title: Genealogy of Saul (Benjamin)

questions.question: Who was the firstborn of Benjamin?
Who was the father of Saul?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 8:33 (ESV): "Ner fathered Kish, Kish fathered Saul..."

questions.question: Who was the son of Jonathan?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 8:34 (ESV): "The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal..."

questions.question: Who were known as mighty warriors and archers?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 8:40 (ESV): "The sons of Ulam were men who were mighty warriors, bowmen..."

questions.question: Where did the chief men of Benjamin live?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 8:28 (ESV): "These lived in Jerusalem." Verse 29 mentions Gibeon. Verse 13 mentions Aijalon.

questions.question: Who drove out the inhabitants of Gath?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 8:13 (ESV): "Beriah and Shema... who drove out the inhabitants of Gath..."

questions.question: Who was the father of Gibeon?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 8:29 (ESV): "Jeiel the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon..."

questions.question: Who was Saul’s firstborn son?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 8:33 (ESV): "...Saul fathered Jonathan, Malchi-shua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal."

questions.question: How many sons had Ulam?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 8:40 (ESV): "...having many sons and grandsons, 150 all told."

questions.question: Who were the wives of Shaharaim?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 8:8-9 (ESV): "...after he had divorced his wives Hushim and Baara. He fathered children by Hodesh his wife..."

questions.question: Who was removed (divorced/sent away) by Shaharaim?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 8:8 (ESV): "...after he had divorced his wives Hushim and Baara."

questions.question: Who was the firstborn of Jeiel?
Who was the brother of Eshek?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 8:39 (ESV): "The sons of Eshek his brother..." Context implies Eshek is brother of Azel (v38).

questions.question: Who carried them into exile (referring to sons of Ehud)?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 8:6-7 (ESV): "...Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, that is, Heglam, who fathered Uzza and Ahihud." Text implies these led the migration/exile to Manahath.

questions.question: Where did the sons of Elpaal build cities?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 8:12 (ESV): "The sons of Elpaal... who built Ono and Lod with its towns..."

key_verse_text: The sons of Ulam were men who were mighty warriors, bowmen, having many sons and grandsons, 150 all told. All these were Benjaminites.
